IndexedColumn.doc: One entry in a CREATE INDEX column list. `desc = true` for DESC; ASC and the absent qualifier both mean ascending. Expression-valued indexed columns (`(a + b)`) are deferred — only bare column names admitted here.

CreateIndexStmt.doc: Parsed CREATE INDEX statement. Covers `CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX [IF NOT EXISTS] <name> ON <table> (<col> [ASC|DESC] [, ...]) [WHERE <expr>]`. Schema-qualified names and indexed-expression columns are deferred. The optional WHERE clause is the partial-index predicate.

CreateIndexParseOk.doc: Successful parse output: the CreateIndexStmt plus the index of the next un-consumed token (typically `;` or `Eof`).

parse_create_index.doc: Parse a `CREATE INDEX` (optionally UNIQUE) statement. Token at `start` must be `KwCreate`. Delegates to parse_expr for the optional partial-index WHERE predicate. Rejects deferred forms (schema-qualified names, indexed expressions, COLLATE in column list) with `deferred: <construct>`.
